editorApprovedScope.scopeInterpretation: Assess whether the Christian explanations actually offered adequately account for suffering. Swinburne offers logical compatibility, responsible choice, character formation, usefulness, creator authority, biblical diversity and redemption; Ehrman challenges adequacy through victims, natural evil, heaven, textual differences and apparent nonintervention.
